import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF_LIMIT = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INF64_LIMIT = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD_LIMIT = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPSILON = 1e-10;

    static final int TIME_HORIZON = 99;
    static final int COST_LEVELS = 15;

    static class FlowNetwork {
        static final int MAX_NODES = 50 * TIME_HORIZON + 2;
        static final int MAX_ARCS = 2 * MAX_NODES * COST_LEVELS + MAX_NODES + 7;

        int[] parent_node = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] first_edge = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] next_arc = new int[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        int[] endpoint = new int[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        int edge_count;

        long[] flow_val = new long[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        long[] cap_val = new long[2 * MAX_ARCS];
        long[] cost_val = new long[2 * MAX_ARCS];

        boolean[] vertex_visited = new boolean[MAX_NODES];
        int[] queue_arr = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] queue_pos = new int[MAX_NODES];

        long[] dist_val = new long[MAX_NODES];
        long[] pot_val = new long[MAX_NODES];

        FlowNetwork() {
            reset_network();
        }

        void reset_network() {
            edge_count = 0;
            Arrays.fill(first_edge, -1);
            Arrays.fill(flow_val, 0);
        }

        void insert_edge(int u, int v, long capacity, long price) {
            int idx = edge_count++;
            next_arc[idx] = first_edge[endpoint[idx] = u];
            first_edge[endpoint[idx]] = idx;
            cap_val[idx] = capacity;
            cost_val[idx] = price;

            idx = edge_count++;
            next_arc[idx] = first_edge[endpoint[idx] = v];
            first_edge[endpoint[idx]] = idx;
            cap_val[idx] = 0;
            cost_val[idx] = -price;
        }

        void setup_potentials(int num_vertices) {
            Arrays.fill(pot_val, 0);
            for (int iter = 1; iter < num_vertices; ++iter) {
                for (int e = 0; e < edge_count; ++e) {
                    if (cap_val[e] != 0) {
                        int from = endpoint[e ^ 1];
                        int to = endpoint[e];
                        if (pot_val[from] > pot_val[to] + cost_val[e]) {
                            pot_val[from] = pot_val[to] + cost_val[e];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        long update_flow(int source, int sink, long[] total_cost, int num_vertices) {
            Arrays.fill(vertex_visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist_val, INF_LIMIT);
            dist_val[source] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(queue_pos, -1);

            int head = 0, tail = 0;
            queue_pos[queue_arr[tail++] = source] = 0;

            while (head < tail) {
                int u = queue_arr[head++];
                queue_pos[u] = -1;

                for (int e = first_edge[u]; e != -1; e = next_arc[e]) {
                    int v = endpoint[e ^ 1];
                    if (flow_val[e] < cap_val[e] && dist_val[v] > dist_val[u] + pot_val[u] - pot_val[v] + cost_val[e]) {
                        dist_val[v] = dist_val[u] + pot_val[u] - pot_val[v] + cost_val[e];
                        parent_node[v] = e;

                        if (queue_pos[v] == -1) {
                            queue_pos[queue_arr[tail] = v] = tail;
                            tail++;
                        }

                        for (int i = queue_pos[v], p = (i - 1) / 2; i > 0 && dist_val[queue_arr[i]] < dist_val[queue_arr[p]]; 
                             i = p, p = (i - 1) / 2) {
                            int temp = queue_arr[i];
                            queue_arr[i] = queue_arr[p];
                            queue_arr[p] = temp;
                            queue_pos[queue_arr[i]] = i;
                            queue_pos[queue_arr[p]] = p;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist_val[sink] >= INF_LIMIT) return 0;

            long augment = INF64_LIMIT;
            for (int node = sink; node != source; node = endpoint[parent_node[node]]) {
                augment = Math.min(augment, cap_val[parent_node[node]] - flow_val[parent_node[node]]);
            }

            for (int node = sink; node != source; node = endpoint[parent_node[node]]) {
                int e = parent_node[node];
                flow_val[e] += augment;
                flow_val[e ^ 1] -= augment;
                total_cost[0] += augment * cost_val[e];
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < num_vertices; ++i) {
                pot_val[i] = Math.min(INF_LIMIT, dist_val[i] + pot_val[i]);
            }

            return augment;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int SOURCE = 0;
        final int SINK = n * TIME_HORIZON + 1;

        FlowNetwork flow_net = new FlowNetwork();

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            flow_net.insert_edge(SOURCE, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < TIME_HORIZON; t++) {
            flow_net.insert_edge(1 + t * n, SINK, INF64_LIMIT, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    flow_net.insert_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF64_LIMIT, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < COST_LEVELS; j++) {
                int cost_coeff = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < TIME_HORIZON; t++) {
                    flow_net.insert_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost_coeff * d + c);
                    flow_net.insert_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost_coeff * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        flow_net.setup_potentials(FlowNetwork.MAX_NODES);

        long[] total_cost = new long[1];
        total_cost[0] = 0;
        long total_flow = 0;

        while (true) {
            long augment = flow_net.update_flow(SOURCE, SINK, total_cost, FlowNetwork.MAX_NODES);
            if (augment == 0) break;
            total_flow += augment;
        }

        if (total_flow != k) {
            throw new AssertionError("Total flow does not match expected flow");
        }
        
        pw.println(total_cost[0]);
        pw.close();
    }
}
